visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young Asian female model with long dark hair and a white tank top sits behind a white table. In front of her is a comprehensive array of skincare products from AHC and Neogence. She smiles warmly at the camera, placing her hands under her chin in a playful pose while looking directly at the viewer. The setting is a brightly lit, minimalist indoor studio with neutral background tones. (2) The camera cuts to a close-up of the model's face as she gently taps her glowing right cheek with her fingers, highlighting her smooth and hydrated skin texture. Yellow and white subtitles appear at the bottom. The model's expression is joyful and confident. (3) A promotional graphic slide appears, showing six professional-looking individuals in white lab coats, with text about a Medical Beauty Summit event. The slide is clean and blue-themed, filling the entire frame. (4) The scene transitions to a close-up of AHC products on the white table, emphasizing the red and white packaging. The model then applies a clear liquid from an AHC bottle onto the back of her hand, followed by a shot of her massaging the product into her facial skin with her palms. (5) Another series of shots focuses on Neogence products, including a distinct blue serum bottle. The model is seen using a glass dropper to apply the blue serum to her face, then spreading it evenly across her forehead and cheeks. (6) The video ends with a full shot of the products and the model smiling behind them once more, followed by a white screen displaying the teal Watsons logo.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The track opens with high-energy electronic pop background music featuring a steady four-on-the-floor beat and bright synthesizer pads. A female narrator with an enthusiastic, high-arousal voice begins speaking at a fast pace with exceptionally clear articulation. (2) A distinct pop sound effect triggers as promotional graphics appear on screen, accompanied by a subtle whoosh transition sound. The background music maintains its tempo while the speaker's tone shifts to an informative delivery for membership benefits. (3) As the narration moves to specific product benefits, the vocal intensity remains high but becomes more intimate. BGM continues with higher frequency synth layers and no significant pauses, creating a dense information flow. (4) A series of digital click and ding sound effects punctuate mentions of specific skin ingredients. The interplay between the driving electronic rhythm and the narrator's rhythmic speech patterns creates a professional commercial-grade audio experience. (5) The finale features a slight swelling of the background music volume as the narrator delivers the final call to action and brand slogan, ending with a clear musical stinger.
